title: mèng
description: a simple modpack that makes minecraft run better, look cleaner and feel smoother.
body:
# mèng / 梦 (dream)

*a minimalist enhancement to the vanilla experience.*

this is a collection of tweaks and optimizations designed to polish the vanilla experience without changing its core. it's for those who love minecraft as it is, but wouldn't mind fewer lag spikes, nicer visuals and some handy quality-of-life features.

## ˗ˏˋ the pillars ˎˊ˗

*   **ˏˋ°• performance & clarity •°ˎˊ**  
    (`sodium`, `lithium`, `ferritecore`, `iris`, `clumps`, `entityculling`, `immediatelyfast`, `dynamic fps`)  
    better frames and smoother gameplay. it removes the technical limits so you can focus on playing.

*   ˏˋ°• **a cleaner look** •°ˎˊ  
    (`visuality`, `lamb dynamic lights`, `model gap fix`, `fadeless`)  
    subtle visual enhancements like dynamic lights, neat particles and configurable visuals. it feels like minecraft, just a bit more polished.

*   ˏˋ°• **useful information** •°ˊ˗  
    (`jade`, `xaero's minimap`, `shulker box tooltip`, `betterf3`, `chat heads`, `pick up notifier`, `light overlay`, `enchantmentdescriptions`)  
    see what you need to see. from what's in a shulker box to where your friends are on the map, all the info is presented clearly.

*   ˏˋ°• **sounds & feel** •°ˎˊ  
    (`sound physics remastered`, `presence footsteps`, `appleskin`, `not enough animations`)  
    more immersive sounds and responsive feedback. hear where things are, see your hunger and get visual cues for what's happening around you.

*   ˏˋ°• **smoother controls** •°ˎˊ  
    (`mouse tweaks`, `nemo's inventory sorting`, `zoomify`)  
    a suite of tweaks that make menus, inventory management and keybindings more intuitive and less of a hassle.

## ˗ˏˋ shaders & texture packs ˎˊ˗

*   **ˏˋ°• visual immersion •°ˎˊ**  
    (`complementary shaders - reimagined`, `even better enchants`, `hide armor`)  
    beautiful water, lighting and shadows • vibrant enchantment glints • optional armor hiding to show off your skin

## ˗ˏˋ configuration & extras ˎˊ˗

*   **ˏˋ°• privacy & utilities •°ˎˊ**  
    (`no chat reports`, `mod menu`, `sodium extra`, `controlling`, `reeses sodium options`)  
    a set of essential tools for customization, accessibility and peace of mind. configure your game to your preferences.
